method: Sum of cases (Confirmed and probable cases reported to MDSS in the column's period, for the area the report states; empty where the report prints '*' (1 to 5 cases).), publisher total rows excluded. A group with any suppressed or missing value has no total (never a partial sum); suppressed_rows gives how many of its values were empty.
